name: ZX_DET_DEFAULT_MAPPING_F
description: ZX_DET_DEFAULT_MAPPING_F contains mappings for defaulting tax determinants.

columns.name: TAX_DET_DEFAULT_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: A unique mapping identifier associated with an individual default tax determinant.

columns.name: DEFAULTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of tax determinant to which a segment in the chart of accounts will default.

columns.name: DEFAULT_MAPPING_CODE
columns.description: A mapping code associated with an individual default tax determinant.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the primary ledger associated with the chart of accounts used as a basis for defaulting specific tax determinants.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: The chart of account segment code associated with a transaction that is used to default a specific tax determinant.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: The chart of account segment value associated with a transaction that is used to default a specific tax determinant.

columns.name: DEFAULTING_VALUE
columns.description: A specific tax determinant value to which a segment in the chart of accounts defaults.

columns.name: DEFAULTING_NUMERIC_VALUE
columns.description: A specific tax determinant identifier to which a segment in the chart of accounts defaults.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Active mapping indicator. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: A lookup code which indicates whether the record is migrated, seeded, or defined by a user.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
